Cc: 
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal evidence & onboarding refresh — next steps

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the renewal preview last week. Procurement at Helio needs to refresh vendor onboarding evidence before we can sign the renewed term. Two asks from our side: 1) a concise mapping of Redwood artifacts to our evidence checklist (SOC2 status, data retention policy, PO process) and 2) confirmation of the earliest PO issuance date if we move forward with the proposed term change (12 → 18 months).

I attached our internal evidence template (we'll upload formally into the portal), but to keep things moving can you confirm what you can provide by end of next week? Also please flag any items that require legal or security redlines so we can triage.

Proposed next step: quick 20m call (Mon/Tue) to align scope and PO timing.

Thanks —
Lara Jensen
Procurement Manager, Helio Systems
procurement@heliosys.com

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence & onboarding refresh — next steps

Hi Lara —

Appreciate the clarity. We can map the artifacts to your template; I'll own the SOC2 + KMS/key management pieces and Ben will own billing/PO pathing. Irene, can you help with retention policy wording and the audit-log exports?

Quick answers up front:
- Earliest PO issuance: we can accept a PO with an effective date as early as 2027-06-01 if signatures are in place by 2027-05-28.
- Items likely to need legal: indemnity language and the clause around data residency if Helio elects EU-only storage.

I'll put together an Evidence_Index.csv that maps Redwood artifacts (report names, location links) to your template fields and share by EOD Monday. Can we do a 20m call Monday 2027-05-17 10:00am PT? If that works, I'll include Legal on the calendar if needed.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma

Subject: Re: Renewal evidence & onboarding refresh — next steps (internal)

Adding a quick internal checklist so we don't miss anything for Helio's portal intake: 

- SOC2: final cert (2026) + scope summary (Done: upload to secure drive).
- Retention: standard 90/365/730 matrix — will create a short paragraph for the template (Irene).
- Audit logs: can provide 30/90/365 export examples; need to confirm CSV/JSON format Helio prefers.
- PO path: Ben to confirm billing contact and PO number format; suggest we accept a single PO for initial 12 months with a contract amendment for months 13–18 to simplify procurement.
- Legal flags: list of potential redlines to send to Legal (indemnity / residency).

Irene — I'll draft the Evidence_Index.csv skeleton with column headers: Helio_field, Redwood_artifact, Location_Link, Notes. Marissa, can you pre-populate with the SOC2 and runtime metrics links?

Thanks — quick internal sync Monday morning 9:00am PT?

Irene Choi
Director, Compliance & Trust | Redwood Inference

Hi Lara —

Per our internal triage, please find attached the Evidence_Index.csv (skeleton populated) and our proposed SLA redline (Helio_Renewal_SLA_v2.pdf). Quick summary:

1) Evidence mapping — attached Evidence_Index.csv maps your template fields to Redwood artifacts and includes direct drive links where the evidence lives. We can provide audit log exports in CSV or JSON; tell us which you prefer and we'll include a 90-day sample.

2) PO timing — we can accept a signed PO effective 2027-06-01 provided approvals are complete and DocuSign is routed by 2027-05-28. If Helio needs more runway, indicate the latest acceptable effective date and we'll propose a bridging amendment.

3) Legal/security flags — indemnity and data residency optionality are the two likely redline areas. I've looped in Irene (Compliance) and Ben (Billing) to help with quick responses; Legal is on standby if you send the specific language.

Next steps: please confirm (a) preferred audit log format (CSV/JSON), (b) PO effective date target, and (c) whether you want Legal involved on the 05/17 call. If you'd like, we can move the call to Tuesday 05/18 10:00am PT.

Warmly,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
